analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Widely
analysis.quote: Cookies might also be used to share your information, including: to Versant; to another party on our behalf; and/or to a third party (e.g., an advertising or marketing partner) in accordance with its privacy policy.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: Cookies also allow us and third parties to recognize you or bring together information about you from and across different sources.

analysis.headline: Third-Parties Share Your Data
analysis.quote: They may share the information they collect through these Cookies with other third parties (e.g., advertisers) according to their privacy policy.

analysis.headline: Social Media Tracks You
analysis.quote: Social media platforms have the ability to track your online activity outside of the Services.

analysis.headline: Opt-Outs Not Fully Effective
analysis.quote: Please be aware that disabling cookies through browsers controls will not disable other technologies we may use to collect information from and about you and you should also set your Cookie settings as described above.

analysis.headline: Tracking Resumes After Deletion
analysis.quote: If you replace, change or upgrade your browser or device, or delete your cookies, you may need to use these settings again.
